theme.title: The dynasty years
theme.subtitle: Chicago Bulls, 1991–98
theme.recap: Chicago won 69 games a year after 72, buried Utah by 42 in a Finals game and then fell to 13 wins once the team broke up.

questions.prompt: How many points did Michael Jordan score in Game 4 of the 1993 Finals against Phoenix?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In Game 4, Michael Jordan was unstoppable, scoring 55 points at Chicago Stadium

questions.prompt: How many games did the 1996–97 Bulls win, a year after going 72–10?
questions.note: 69–13, the league's best record that season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Bulls settled for a league-best 69–13 record
